misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen forecast specification linked to its issuance time, evidence cutoff, and matured outcome could make a candidate-level assessment possible. The supplied evidence does not show that such a record would have changed any decision or prevented a loss.
misses.decision_reference: The supplied settlement records contain no linked prior forecast specification, issuance time, or eligible evidence cutoff. Registry references: EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE.
misses.decision_relevance: Without forecast-to-outcome lineage, target-time prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or demonstrate a decision failure. This is an auditability gap, not a demonstrated decision miss.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: Confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices are supplied, but the repository evidence states that they are not linked to eligible prior forecast specifications or decision-time evidence. No forecast miss or action failure is established. This discovery episode does not validate the proposed metric.
misses.missing_history_problem: Frozen forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. Settlement target timestamps are adjudication times, not decision or source-observation timestamps.
misses.outcome_reference: Supplied FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36; records provide confirmed target-time prices but no linked prior forecast specifications.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
